title: Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Countertop Solid Brass | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass | Paper Towel Rack Stand Kitchen | Allied Brass
description:
Keep a full roll within reach and your kitchen counter organized with this countertop paper towel holder in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any kitchens. This paper towel holder (also called a paper towel rack or paper towel stand) is designed to sit on the counter as a valet-style holder.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Coordinate your space with a distinctive look from the Brass Paper Towel Holders collection
- Install with a clean look using concealed screw mounting hardware
- Coordinate with surrounding fixtures using multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product: Countertop paper towel holder / paper towel rack / paper towel stand
- Room: Kitchen
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 5 in. x 14 in. x 5 in.
- Mounting terms: concealed screw mounting hardware (mount), wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging terms not applicable to this countertop model
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
